node.statement: By lem-routef-raw-factor-norms, applicable because eta<=rho_T, ||tilde-Delta_n(X_t)|| <= (1+C_V*eta)||X|| and ||tilde-Delta_n(Y_t)|| <= 1+C_V*eta. Submultiplicativity in M_n(B(H)) and C_V*eta<=1/4 therefore give ||Z_t|| <= (1+C_V*eta)^2||X|| <= (5/4)^2||X|| <= 4||X||.
